title: Check Tipper OPC Connection Status in Ignition Gateway
summary: Use the Ignition gateway Config > OPC > OPC Connections view to inspect current tipper OPC connection states and compare each displayed status with the observed or site-confirmed powered state.
when_to_use: Use this diagnostic when checking whether tipper OPC connections in the Ignition gateway currently show Connected or Faulted, especially when the displayed state needs to be compared with the live or site-confirmed powered state of the tipper.
not_for: Do not use this check alone to infer a broader system failure.
Do not use this procedure as a repair, restart, or recovery procedure; the source does not provide remediation steps.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support performs the live status inspection in the Ignition gateway and records the affected connection and displayed status.
L1_support obtains or uses a site-confirmed tipper powered state for comparison.
Escalate to L2_support when the displayed OPC state does not correspond to the observed tipper powered state or when deeper support is required.
access_or_tools_needed: Ignition gateway Config > OPC > OPC Connections view
Live or site-confirmed tipper powered state

access_required: Access to the Ignition gateway UI.
system_preconditions: The relevant tipper powered state is observable or confirmed by the site.

steps.title: Open the Ignition gateway OPC Connections view
steps.purpose: Access the live Ignition gateway page that displays current OPC connection states.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition gateway, navigate to Config > OPC > OPC Connections.
steps.expected_result: The Ignition gateway OPC Connections page opens and displays the current connection entries with their status values.
steps.healthy_condition: The OPC Connections page is reachable and current connection entries are displayed.
steps.failure_condition: The OPC Connections page cannot be reached or does not display the current connection entries.

actions.label: Navigate to OPC Connections
actions.exact_action: Open the Ignition gateway and select Config > OPC > OPC Connections.

stop_or_escalate_if: The Ignition gateway OPC Connections page is unavailable or does not display current connection entries.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Ignition Gateway UI under Config > OPC > OPC Connections; current connections can be viewed.

steps.title: Review the displayed OPC connection states
steps.purpose: Identify the current state of each relevant tipper OPC connection.
steps.instruction: In the Ignition gateway Config > OPC > OPC Connections list, review the displayed status for the relevant connections and distinguish Connected from Faulted.
steps.expected_result: Each relevant connection has a visible status, such as Connected or Faulted.
steps.healthy_condition: A connection displays Connected when its current OPC connection state is available.
steps.failure_condition: A relevant connection displays Faulted, or its status is missing or cannot be determined.

actions.label: Inspect connection statuses
actions.exact_action: Review the current connection entries and their displayed Connected or Faulted status in Config > OPC > OPC Connections.

stop_or_escalate_if: A relevant connection displays Faulted and the corresponding tipper powered state has not yet been confirmed.
The displayed status is missing, ambiguous, or cannot be matched to the relevant tipper connection.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Ignition OPC Connections view displays current connection states including Connected and Faulted.

steps.title: Compare tipper OPC status with the powered state
steps.purpose: Determine whether a displayed Faulted state corresponds to the observed powered condition of the tipper.
steps.instruction: For each relevant tipper connection in the Ignition gateway Config > OPC > OPC Connections view, compare the displayed status with the live or site-confirmed powered state. In the documented example, tipper 7 and tipper 8 are powered off and display Faulted.
steps.expected_result: The displayed OPC state is recorded together with the corresponding tipper powered state, including whether a Faulted state occurs while the tipper is powered off.
steps.healthy_condition: The displayed state matches the observed equipment state; for example, a powered-off tipper may display Faulted, while available connections display Connected.
steps.failure_condition: A connection displays Faulted while the corresponding tipper is observed or confirmed powered on, or the displayed state does not match the live equipment state.

actions.label: Compare OPC and powered states
actions.exact_action: Compare the tipper connection status shown in Ignition gateway Config > OPC > OPC Connections with the live or site-confirmed powered state of the tipper.

actions.label: Confirm equipment state
actions.exact_action: Use a live or site-confirmed tipper powered state for the comparison.

stop_or_escalate_if: A connection displays Faulted without the corresponding tipper being powered off.
The displayed OPC state does not match the observed live equipment state.
Record the affected connection and displayed status, then escalate for deeper support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: In the example, tipper 7 and tipper 8 are powered off and show Faulted; other displayed OPC connections show Connected.

success_criteria: The Ignition gateway Config > OPC > OPC Connections page is reached.
The relevant tipper connection entries and their displayed Connected or Faulted states are identified.
Each displayed state is compared with the live or site-confirmed powered state.
Any mismatch is recorded with the affected connection and escalated rather than interpreted as a broader system failure from this check alone.
healthy_conditions: The Ignition gateway OPC Connections page displays the current connection entries.
A powered-off tipper may display Faulted, as shown for tipper 7 and tipper 8 in the documented example.
Displayed connection states correspond to the observed tipper powered states.
failure_conditions: A relevant OPC connection displays Faulted while the corresponding tipper is powered on.
The displayed connection state does not match the observed live equipment state.
The Ignition gateway OPC Connections page or current connection entries are unavailable.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to L2_support when a connection displays Faulted without the corresponding tipper being powered off.
Escalate when the displayed OPC state does not match the observed live equipment state.
Include the affected connection and displayed status in the follow-up.
Do not infer a broader system failure from this check alone.
The source does not provide connection repair, restart, or recovery instructions.
